brief:
A Palestinian American activist was denied entry to the United Kingdom to attend his charity's annual Gaza fundraiser, Al Jazeera English reported. The refusal marks the latest instance of alleged restrictions on pro-Palestine voices in Britain.

The activist's exclusion comes as concerns mount over entry bans targeting individuals who support Palestinian causes. Critics contend the UK is using immigration powers to suppress speech and advocacy related to Gaza.
dek: A Palestinian American activist has been refused entry to the UK to attend his charity’s annual Gaza fundraiser.
title: UK bars Palestinian American activist from entering country
